cases.answer: In external validation on the MS-AF wearable-ECG dataset, the Lorenz-scattergram CNN diagnosed AF with sensitivity 0.989, specificity 0.956 and accuracy 0.967 (PPV 0.916, NPV 0.994, AUC 0.987) at the LS-segment level. At the ECG-record level on the 113 MS-AF records, it detected paroxysmal AF with sensitivity 1.000, specificity 0.870 and accuracy 0.876 (PPV only 0.263), and persistent AF with sensitivity 0.927, specificity 1.000 and accuracy 0.973. The key limitation is that the external MS-AF dataset contained only five paroxysmal-AF patients, a very small number and low proportion, which the authors say may affect the test results (and is reflected in the low PPV of 0.263 for paroxysmal AF).

claims.claim: External LS-level AF detection performance: sensitivity 0.989, specificity 0.956, accuracy 0.967
claims.quote: In the external validation set, the sensitivity of the model for diagnosing AF was 0.989, the specificity was 0.956, and the accuracy was 0.967.

claims.claim: External validation set also had PPV 0.916, NPV 0.994 and AUC 0.987
Record-level external paroxysmal AF performance: sensitivity 1.000, specificity 0.870, accuracy 0.876 (PPV 0.263)
claims.quote: The sensitivity of the model diagnosis of paroxysmal AF was 1.000, the specificity was 0.870, and the accuracy was 0.876.

claims.claim: Record-level persistent AF performance: sensitivity 0.927, specificity 1.000, accuracy 0.973
claims.quote: The sensitivity of the model diagnosis of persistent AF was 0.927, the specificity was 1.000, and the accuracy was 0.973.

claims.claim: Limitation: the external MS-AF dataset contained only five paroxysmal-AF patients, which may affect test results
claims.quote: the number of patients with paroxysmal AF was only five patients in the MS-AF dataset, which is a low number and a low proportion of AF patients in the current study. This may affect the test results of the model.

other_candidates.quote: In the internal validation set, the sensitivity of the model for diagnosing AF was 0.992, the specificity was 0.973, and the accuracy was 0.983.
other_candidates.why_rejected: Internal (not external) validation performance, which the question did not ask about.

cases.ambiguity: 'External AF-detection performance' could be read as either the LS-segment-level metrics (Sen 0.989 / Spe 0.956 / Acc 0.967) or the ECG-record-level metrics (paroxysmal AF: 1.000/0.870/0.876; persistent AF: 0.927/1.000/0.973); both are reported and both are given above.
